answer: Require every agent identity to stake tokens that unlock only after a history of attested work: newcomers get tiny job limits, and only completed, peer-verified tasks raise their quota. Like a garden, trust must be grown over time, not planted overnight, so one operator spinning up thousands of fresh identities pays the stake and waits through the same slow voyage toward credibility for each. A vine of cross-checks between clients and auditors then exposes clusters sharing funds or behavior, making a thousand fake trusted agents far costlier than one real one.
